title: Doc-DiMB-RE: Constructing Document-Level Diet–Microbiome Associations with LLM-Based Entity Linking
authors: Gibong Hong, Yikun Han, Jyot Buch, Sirapop Umnakkittikul, and Halil Kilicoglu
abstract: Introduces Doc-DiMB-RE, a document-level dataset for extracting diet–microbiome–disease relationships, together with a multi-ontology entity-linking framework that combines SapBERT candidate retrieval with LLM-based reranking. The work aims to standardize biomedical concepts across nine ontologies and support reliable knowledge-graph construction.

title: CIH-KG: A Provenance-Aware, Biolink-Aligned Knowledge Graph Integrating Complementary and Integrative Health Evidence
authors: Yikun Han, Cesar Bernabe, Jyot Buch, Drshika Asher, Luigi Marini, Cui Tao, Rui Zhang, and Halil Kilicoglu
abstract: Presents CIH-KG, a provenance-aware, Biolink-aligned integration of 14 complementary and integrative health data sources. The graph contains 111,940 nodes and 963,789 edges and is designed to support cross-resource retrieval, graph completion, and hypothesis generation while preserving source attribution.
